dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: There has been significant monster activity recently near Stone Gate and Dihua Marsh. Millelith patrols have been increased, and we ask all traveling merchants to take caution when passing through.

dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Last day of clearance sale! Come get famous Scent of Spring wares at a huge discount!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Only in this village, this store! Everything, must, go!"

dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "All your travel essentials, right here!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "They say rare merchandise are sound investments. Any traveling merchants in need of such are welcome to come visit my hypermarket in Dihua Marsh!"

dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Pops Zhou welcomes all travelers to come by and relax with a big cup of cheap, refreshing tea!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Note
dialogues.text: "Having known Pops Zhou for 40 years, I can vouch that his tea hasn't declined in quality one bit... though it hasn't improved either."

dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: Many Treasure Hoarders have been spotted recently near Stone Gate and Dihua Marsh. Passersby should take caution.

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: If you see anything suspicious, please first get to safety and then report the situation immediately to the nearest Millelith soldier.

dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "May the Lord of Geo protect us on our journey to a faraway land, a new home where we can start a life all our own..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "...I only hope that our painstaking planning and past mistakes were not all for nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "'The gleaming blade reveals scarlet rain in forest shadows; I only hope that many-a-drink may drown my sorrows.' — A swordsman with no understanding of poetic verse. Feedback welcome."

dialogues.speaker: Another Note
dialogues.text: "In my humble opinion... the second line makes absolutely no sense!"

dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Let's set off on an adventure among the delicacies of Mondstadt!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "In the nation of wind and wine, does even the food taste of a cool breeze and fragrant wine?"

dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Guhua...Legend...Sword...adepti in the mist...evildoer..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I...writing...remarkable...this poem..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: (The handwriting is so poor that the rest is completely illegible.)

dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: Welcome to Stone Gate, the door of Liyue! From here head south to the bustling port city, or north to the rustic land of wine.

dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "A wealthy-looking girl dressed in purple came by here a few days ago, asking all sorts of things about the land, people's daily consumption, and such. She seemed to be from the city."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "When I asked who she was, she said she was a general secretary from Yujing Terrace, sure enough. City folk really are thorough at their job..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "You seldom see such vigorous, resolute demeanor in young people these days."
